prompt:
Port 8080 is moving to 9090 and a cache time to live of 600 seconds is being added. Edit these files, and only these files, exactly as listed. The files use different encodings, byte order marks, line endings and endings of the file. After your edit every file must have the same encoding, the same byte order mark (or none), the same line ending on every line and the same ending (with or without a final newline) as before, and every non ASCII character must still be the same character.

1. config/app.ini: in [server] change port to 9090. In [ui] change title to `Café Ordering Zürich`. In [cache] add the line `ttl = 600` after the line `backend = memory`.
2. config/legacy.conf: change `Listen 8080` to `Listen 9090`, add the line `LogLevel warn` directly after it, change `MaxClients 150` to `MaxClients 300`, and change the last line to `Contact Müller & Söhne AG`.
3. src/settings.js: set DEFAULT_PORT to 9090, change REGION to "Zürich (Altstadt)", and add the line `export const CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 600;` directly after the CURRENCY line.
4. src/server.js: add CACHE_TTL_SECONDS to the import, so the import line is `import { DEFAULT_PORT, REGION, CACHE_TTL_SECONDS } from "./settings.js";`, and change the console.log line to `  console.log("Listening on port " + DEFAULT_PORT + " in " + REGION + " (ttl " + CACHE_TTL_SECONDS + "s)");`.
5. deploy/deploy.ps1: change `$Port = 8080` to `$Port = 9090`, add the line `$Ttl = 600` directly after it, and change the Write-Host line to `Write-Host "Déploiement terminé sur le port $Port"`.
6. data/regions.csv: change the port of the ZH row to 9090 and add the row `SP,São Paulo,8083` at the end of the file.
7. locales/de.yaml: change port_label to `"Anschluss 9090"` and add the line `ttl_label: "Gültigkeit 600 s"` as the new last line. This file has no newline at the very end today, and it must still have none after the edit.
8. README.txt: change every 8080 to 9090 (there are three).

config/other.ini belongs to another team and also contains 8080. Do not change it, and do not change locales/en.yaml. Do not leave backup or temporary files in the project.
